annotation.title_clean: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.title_en: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ruler of Dubai (Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum); Supreme Legislation Committee in the Emirate of Dubai
named_instruments_referenced: UAE Federal Civil Code (Law No. 5 of 1985)
UAE Federal Road Traffic Law No. 21 of 1995

annotation.summary_en: Dubai law issued 6 April 2023 that sets the legal framework for operating autonomous vehicles in the emirate. It makes the Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) the regulator. Vehicles must be licensed and anyone carrying out related activities needs a permit. The law also covers technical standards and inspections, data handling and oversight. Federal traffic law applies where this law says nothing.
key_provisions_or_claims: No autonomous vehicle may travel on Dubai roads unless it is licensed by the RTA
Any activity using autonomous vehicles requires an RTA permit, including for vehicles licensed elsewhere in the UAE
The RTA sets technical specifications, carries out inspections, compiles data from vehicle operation and monitors permit holders
Defines an autonomous vehicle as one controlled without human intervention, excluding driver-assistance systems
The law comes into force 90 days after publication, and federal traffic law fills any gaps
